name: CBG plan_rejected_retry → stamp plan-retry markers on run entity
description:
ADR-044 §addendum Slice 6 — plan-retry stamp half (plan-phase analog of rule 07c). Fires when CBG (plan-review mode) decides plan_rejected_retry: the plan dropped a constraint or emitted a build-not-test, and a re-plan can fix it. Stamps two markers on the RUN entity (via lineage.run-loop-entity-id subject override):

- dev_via_test.plan.retry.finding (update_triple, upsert) = CBG's reason — the concrete fidelity fix Lisa must apply, surfaced to the re-planning Lisa.
- dev_via_test.plan.retry.pending (add_triple) = this CBG loop id — the presence marker that triggers the run-entity driver (rule 02d).

Unlike the work-retry (07c), there is NO target_task: the whole plan is the target, and Lisa re-emits a corrected plan. Bounded by plan.lisa_retry_budget via rule 02d's $state.iteration.

metadata.vs_07c: Plan-phase analog of the work-retry stamp (07c). No target_task — the plan is the unit, re-emitted whole. finding upserts so the latest CBG verdict wins; pending is the content-free trigger 02d removes each cycle.
metadata.subject_override_requires: semstreams #147/#148. The CBG plan-review loop carries lineage.run-loop-entity-id from rule 02's related_loops.
